title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. We had intended to purchase a flat about 10 years back and for the same we had given an amount of Rs.160000 (Rupees One Lac Sixty Thousand only) to the builder. Unfortunately, the building never got complete and the builder was not able to return us the money either. Now after 10 years or so, we were able to settle the matter through a shop which the builder gave to us in return of the money. We sold this shop and got back Rs.150000 (Rupees One Lac Fifty Thousand Only). My question is are we obliged to pay Zakat on this amount for the 10 years. If yes, please oblige by giving us the way of calculating the same. 2034 views Q. What is the procedure of zakat. 1912 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 47542 Country: India Title: Zakah Question: I have been paying zakah during the holy months of Ramadan on gold and Jewelleries held by my family. I have returned to my home country after my retirement and do not have pension payment scheme and any kind of other source of income but I have saved funds during my job to meet with my future expenses, now these funds are being used to meet my day to day expenses. Please let me know urgently whether payment of zakah is applicable keeping in view the above elaborated situation. Answer ID: 47542 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1148/898/D=10/1434) It is wajib on you to pay 2.5% zakah after completing one year on the cash available in your fund or other cash, gold and silver which you own. Zakah shall be wajib on the amount of fund so long as it is in form of cash though it is meant for future expenses. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
